reviews.review:
It may only show I've played only a few mins of this game but having played the PS3 version to death I can seriously recommend this game to anyone the gameplay is good all round action and the story is also very good, the world of Warhammer is amazing the lore of it is huge. I once googled about 1 faction and the lore of it took me a good 2hrs+ to read it all, the PC version has the better framerate an better graphics than the PS3 version but both are very stable.

If you like action 3rd peron shooter games and also are a fan of the warhammer universe this is a great game to play even if your not a fan of it and might be curious it's worth playing. Even though Captain Titus doesn't really exsist in the Warhammer World he is a rather cool character and he fits the story of the game very well. Voice acting is spot on I really do like the characters a lot and the fact the ORGES are scottish makes me giggle. It's a shame though that THQ and Relic have no vanished and are no more but I know one developer did buy out the IP, so we may see a Warhammer: Space Marine 2 some day because the story is that good you seriously need a sequel.

Such a great game. I think this is the first game I've ever played through in one sitting and beat it.
Like you would expect from WarHammer it has:
-Blood
-Killings
-Orkz
-Heresy
-Lots of blood
-Awesome Space Marine Action
-So much genocide
-Slow motion skull crushing attacks with massive hammer
-A cliff hanger
-Stabbing Orkz through the balls with a chain blade and keeping it there for a while
-More blood than a blood bank has
-Bloody Inquisitors
-Battle Brothers
-Codex Astartes
-A shocking betrayal or two
-Jet Packs
-Bolters
-Pathetic Imperial Guardsmen
-Guardsmen acting like Space Marines are the Emperor himself
-And lots and lots of killing

The only thing that bothers me from time to time in the campaign is that it doesn't want to hide that it is linear as [strike]hell[/strike] [i]the warp[/i]. Otherwise, the 40k feeling I came for is more than achieved. Love it.
Get this game or see your nearest local Commissar for reeducation
